## Chicago Lease Clause Review for a 2026-07-01 Move-In
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/house.svg

You’ve got a few **good negotiation targets** here. The main tenant-friendly goal is to narrow vague landlord rights, cap your repair exposure, and make renewal/entry terms more balanced.

## Tenant-Friendly Negotiation Checklist
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/check2-square.svg

| Clause | Main risk | Tenant-friendly ask | Why it helps |
|---|---|---|---|
| Rent increase after month 6 with 30 days’ notice | Rent can rise mid-lease with short notice | Remove increase during the 12-month term, or require a fixed rent for all 12 months | Keeps your budget predictable |
| No subletting without written approval | Approval can be withheld arbitrarily | Add “consent not to be unreasonably withheld or delayed” | Gives you a realistic exit option |
| Tenant pays plumbing repairs under $150 | You may pay for normal wear-and-tear or building issues | Limit to tenant-caused damage only; exclude clogs, leaks, and aging fixtures | Prevents paying for landlord maintenance |
| Landlord entry with 12 hours’ notice | Short notice can feel intrusive | Ask for 24 hours’ notice except emergencies, during reasonable hours | Better privacy and planning |
| Automatic renewal unless notice 45 days before end | Easy to miss; may lock you in | Shorten notice to 30 days or require landlord reminder notice | Reduces accidental renewal risk |

## Practical Risks to Watch
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/exclamation-triangle.svg

- **Mid-lease rent increases:** This is the biggest budget risk. If the lease is truly 12 months, push for rent to stay fixed through the term.
- **Repair cost shifting:** “Plumbing repairs under $150” is broad. It can cover minor issues that are not your fault.
- **Entry rights:** 12 hours’ notice is short and can be used too often unless limited to reasonable hours and non-emergencies.
- **Auto-renewal trap:** Missing a 45-day deadline can extend the lease unexpectedly.
- **Sublet restriction:** A strict approval clause can make it hard to move for work or personal reasons.

## Negotiation Email Draft
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/envelope.svg

Subject: Proposed Lease Edits for 2026-07-01 Lease

Hi [Landlord/Property Manager Name],

Thanks for sending over the proposed lease. I’m excited about the apartment and would like to move forward, but I’d appreciate a few edits to make the lease more balanced and predictable.

Could we please revise the following points:
- Keep rent fixed for the full 12-month term, with no increase after month 6
- Update the subletting clause so consent cannot be unreasonably withheld
- Limit plumbing repair charges to tenant-caused damage only
- Change landlord entry notice to 24 hours except in emergencies
- Shorten the automatic renewal notice period to 30 days, or add a reminder notice before the deadline

If you’re open to these changes, I’m happy to review a revised draft and continue the process.

Best,
[Your Name]
